notes.title: Combat Update!
notes.notes:
The combat update gives new actions and abilities to many of the games enemies as well as a new upgradable tool for the RC's defense systems

[u][b]Enemy Upgrades[/b][/u]

To keep combat from feeling too straight forward, the enemies of Kent Island Prison have learned a couple of new tricks.  Even running can sometimes be a challenge now...

- Standard Ghost Enemies have been given the ability to dodge left and right.  This has two new effects in that it can make it more challenging to just use the Focus Beam on them, however occasionally while trying to run past them they will actually use the maneuver to block your path.

- Ghosts have also been given a new lunge attack to help them close the gap when in a mid range state.  Previously ghosts would often just walk towards you while taking damage, now you'll have to be on your toes to watch for their attack.

- Shadows have also been given a new mid range strike that moves much faster.  Watch for their wind up because they hit hard and fast now.

- One of the bosses has also been given a new lunge attack to help close the distance while pursuing you.

[u][b]New Defense System[/b][/u]

To help defend against the new maneuvers of your foes, the RC has been given the ability to manually use an upgraded version of the Shield Blast.  Previously the Shield Blast would only trigger when taking damage, however now you can pre-empt an enemy attack with the push of a button, usually clearing you from harms way.

- Shield Blast is upgradable similar to the RC weapons and Batteries with three levels each decreasing the recharge time needed for another blast.

- Shield does still trigger when taking damage, however this doesn't count against the manual charge amount.

-Shield Blast has been added to the RC UI so you can track the current charge availability (both visually and audibly)



[u][b]Other Improvements[/b][/u]

- Combat tweaks and balancing

- Substantial visual upgrade to most areas of the Prison with new textures and models throughout.

- New particles effects for enemies to better signify damage and movement (teleportation)

-  UI / CX enhancements to menu's for a cleaner user experience.

notes.title: Shutter 2 - Year Two
notes.notes:
Year Two see's the halls of Kent Island Prison refreshed and re-stocked with brand new enemy designs and animations.

Updated enemy AI and animation mechanics create even more difficult combat scenarios, while improved  textures, models and lighting bring the horrific atmosphere to new levels.

Classic mode also introduces a new threat with enemies that can spawn at any moment making your camera skills more important than ever.

[previewyoutube=gwVN4w3xwl4;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]Update Overview:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] All enemies have received updated character models as well as new animations and mechanics that effect combat.
[*] Some enemies have been redesigned from the ground up, utilizing root motion animations for a completely different combat experience.
[*] Boss fights have been balanced along with the new animations.
[*] Tons of new graphical details have been added to Kent Island Prison such as brand new textures, environmental details, particle effects and overhauled lighting in certain levels.
[*] Enemies now randomly spawn in Classic mode.  Keep your eyes, ears and camera sharp.
[/list]

notes.title: Inventory Map Update!
notes.notes:
[list]
[*] Player's inventory and mini-map now show players exact location and direction facing (previously was just a static map showing what room you were in) while in the the prison.

[*] Map will now open to current floor and an Icon will be placed beside the level that the player is currently on while navigating maps

[*] Destroyed RC is now given an exact location when retrieving it

[*] Some areas have expanded hallways and altered layout to match the new map

[*] Detail and texture pass on some areas

[*] Various minor bug fixes and UX improvements
[/list]

notes.title: Substantial Visual Updates
notes.notes:
- New details have been added to almost every scene in the game.

- Some areas have been expanded upon, creating new environments and in some areas expanding on how puzzles are approached.

- Textures have been updated and overhauled in many areas for a richer atmosphere

- New particle effects added in many areas.

- Other small bug fixes and quality of life changes for a better user experience.

notes.title: Tutorial overhaul and Special Item X-ray
notes.notes:
- Opening tutorial has been overhauled and spaced out to provide information on a more contextual basis.

- Special items now have been given an X-ray overlay when player is close, making them easier to locate in dark / obstructed areas

- Small visual updates to some environments

notes.title: Photography mode / puzzle mode enhancements
notes.notes:
- Streamlined process for photographs taken in game so that only photos with evidence get added to your inventory.   Random photos are automatically discarded.  (this helps keep the inventory from filling up too quickly)

- Player is now prompted automatically when a valuable photograph has been added to the inventory

- Important puzzle photos are now given a visual highlight to help players locate them easier.  

- Improvements made to UX controls for ease of interaction with objects.

notes.title: New "normal" difficulty settings added
notes.notes:
- Difficulty settings have been balanced 
- Added a new "normal" difficulty setting as well as a "hard" difficulty setting.
- Settings mostly affect combat and amount of recharges available

notes.title: Controller Support for Xbox 360 controllers added!
notes.notes:
- Full XBOX 360 controller support has been added

- Numerous updates to UI features

- Small visual upgrades to environments throughout the game.

notes.title: Auto-save feature added
notes.notes:
New auto-save feature added!

-The game will now save to a separate file when you complete puzzle sequences and reach other in game milestones.

-Small visual upgrade to some areas.

notes.title: Mini map and Objectives Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, thanks for your continued interest in Shutter 2!

For better navigation of Kent Island Prison, I've decided to add in a brand new mini-map and objective system to help keep players focused in the early stages of the game.  Special items and story notes will now get marked on your map if you come across them (both your pause map and in-game mini-map).  A Compass has also been added into the mini-map to help players orient themselves regardless of whether they have chosen the static cameras or over the shoulder cam.

[u][b]Key points for this update:[/b][/u]

- added a new mini-map with directional compass for better navigation. (Map can be hidden with the 'M' key for those who prefer a more traditional experience)
- added an objective update system, areas of interest will now be highlighted on your pause map.
- cleaned up and simplified the intro tutorial for the game
- simplified some UI controls
- added a variety of animations for the ghost enemies
- altered attack strength for late game enemies to increase difficulty
- visual polish to various areas around the prison
- upgraded texture for shadow enemies.
-various other tweaks and bug fixes.

notes.title: Shutter 2 - The Depths
notes.notes:
[h1]Shutter 2 – The Depths[/h1]

The horror of Kent Island Prison is renowned, but the blood runs deeper than anyone ever knew.

In Shutter 2 - The Depths, new areas of Kent Island Prison have been unearthed to explore.  Go beneath the surface and experience the original terror that Kent Island was built on in the Old Prison, and brace yourself as you battle an enemy born of pure darkness. This new enemy will test your skills and your sanity as it cloaks itself in shadow and attacks without warning.

[previewyoutube=wzTMHigs-3Q;full][/previewyoutube]

Two new areas with brand new puzzles and puzzle mechanics have been introduced, creating a deeper and more complete experience beneath the halls of Kent Island.

Shutter 2 - The Depths unearths an evil older than the prison itself and plunges the player further down the void than ever before.

Additions with this update:

[list]
[*] A new enemy type that requires new tactics to deepen combat 
[*] Two brand new areas with new puzzles and mechanics 
[*] Weapons and combat balancing for the Standard / Casual game modes
[*] Enemies have been re-imagined in both design and AI for a more balanced / weighted combat experience
[*] Texture and lighting overhaul to many areas
[*] Enhanced models and textures for characters
[/list]

notes.title: Shutter 2 Classic Mode!
notes.notes:
[h1]Announcing Shutter 2 Classic Mode![/h1]
  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38892784/abd4459635ddb1f6fcdc2c33ef88b38bb5e8cd58.png[/img]

As an homage to the original Shutter, a new mode has been added that focuses on puzzles and pictures, but don't confuse the silence for safety... there's a new threat lurking in the halls of Kent Island Prison, and it can come for you at any moment.

In Shutter 2 Classic Mode, gameplay has been simplified with weapons and standard enemy combat being removed. However, a new enemy that relentlessly stalks you and can appear at almost any moment has surfaced in the prison. Hold your ground and try to photograph it, or find temporary safety in another room - just don't let it get too close.

For fans of horror streaming, Shutter 2 Classic Mode creates a perfect environment for highly screamable moments.  The scares are completely unscripted and the tension continues to build in the silence as you wait for the next encounter.

Boss battles have also been reworked to focus on the photography element which creates a simplified yet still challenging experience.

If you're already a R.A.V.E.N Shield veteran or looking to become a new recruit,  Shutter 2 Classic Mode creates another terrifying reason to suit up and go looking for paranormal paraphernalia.

[h3]Other additions with this update:[/h3]
[list]
[*]  Brand new voiced dialogue from your handler Barry, keeping you connected to the R.A.V.E.N Shield headquarters
[*]  Weapons and combat balancing for the Standard / Casual game modes
[*]  A new in-game tutorial that gets you into the action quicker
[*]  User experience updates to existing puzzles
[*]  Optional access to the original tutorial mode at any point you need
[*]  A new settings menu to help you find your play preferences
[*]  New settings and control options


[/list]
